description: Persistence foundation for the cluster cost snapshot: a ClusterCostSnapshot JPA entity, its Spring Data repository (with the prior-period read-back query), and an idempotent Flyway migration. Modeled exactly on WorkloadVerticalAction + V20261013_1__vertical_workload_action.sql. This feature is additive and inert on its own (nothing writes or reads snapshots yet); FEAT-002 writes rows and FEAT-003 reads them back. Must come first — FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 both depend on the entity + repository.
steps: Create xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/domain/ClusterCostSnapshot.java as @Entity @Table(name="cluster_cost_snapshot"), copying the structure of domain/WorkloadVerticalAction.java: @Id @GeneratedValue(GenerationType.IDENTITY) Long id; @Column(name="cluster_config_id", nullable=false) Long clusterConfigId (a PLAIN Long logical-FK column, NO @ManyToOne); @Column(name="cluster_monthly_cost", nullable=false) double clusterMonthlyCost; @Column(name="captured_at", nullable=false) java.time.Instant capturedAt. Add @PrePersist that sets capturedAt = Instant.now() when null. Add getters/setters (and optionally an all-args convenience constructor + a no-arg constructor required by JPA). Javadoc: explain it is scoped by kubernetes_cluster_config.id (never the ambiguous cloud_account_id, audit B4) and that column types match what Hibernate maps so UAT ddl-auto=update and Flyway never fight.

Create xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/repository/ClusterCostSnapshotRepository.java as @Repository interface extends JpaRepository<ClusterCostSnapshot, Long>. Add the prior-period finder: Optional<ClusterCostSnapshot> findTopByClusterConfigIdAndCapturedAtLessThanEqualOrderByCapturedAtDesc(Long clusterConfigId, java.time.Instant cutoff). Add a plain newest-overall finder for tests: Optional<ClusterCostSnapshot> findTopByClusterConfigIdOrderByCapturedAtDesc(Long clusterConfigId).

Create xamops-service/src/main/resources/db/migration/V20261022_1__cluster_cost_snapshot.sql copying the comment+DDL style of V20261013_1__vertical_workload_action.sql: a header comment block explaining purpose, the IF NOT EXISTS guard + why (shared xamops_db_uat, ddl-auto=update), canonical identifiers, and the DROP TABLE IF EXISTS reversal. DDL: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cluster_cost_snapshot ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, cluster_config_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES kubernetes_cluster_config(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, cluster_monthly_cost DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, captured_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL ); then CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_cluster_cost_snapshot_cluster_captured ON cluster_cost_snapshot (cluster_config_id, captured_at); then COMMENT ON TABLE / key COLUMNs. No destructive DDL; touches no existing table.
acceptance_criteria: ClusterCostSnapshot entity exists with a plain Long cluster_config_id column (no @ManyToOne), a double cluster_monthly_cost, and an Instant captured_at with a @PrePersist stamp.

The migration file V20261022_1__cluster_cost_snapshot.sql uses CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS and CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS, references kubernetes_cluster_config(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, and contains no destructive DDL.
verification: grep -c 'IF NOT EXISTS' src/main/resources/db/migration/V20261022_1__cluster_cost_snapshot.sql  # expect >= 2 (sanity only; the authoritative DB check is FEAT-003's H2 slice test)
findings: Entity: com.xammer.cloud.domain.ClusterCostSnapshot (@Entity @Table(name="cluster_cost_snapshot")). Fields + accessors: Long getId()/setId(Long); Long getClusterConfigId()/setClusterConfigId(Long) -> column cluster_config_id (plain Long logical FK, NO @ManyToOne); double getClusterMonthlyCost()/setClusterMonthlyCost(double) -> column cluster_monthly_cost (primitive double -> DOUBLE PRECISION); Instant getCapturedAt()/setCapturedAt(Instant) -> column captured_at (TIMESTAMPTZ). @PrePersist onCreate() stamps capturedAt=Instant.now() when null. Constructors: no-arg (JPA) + all-args convenience ClusterCostSnapshot(Long clusterConfigId, double clusterMonthlyCost, Instant capturedAt). Repository: com.xammer.cloud.repository.ClusterCostSnapshotRepository extends JpaRepository<ClusterCostSnapshot, Long>. Query methods (exact signatures): Optional<ClusterCostSnapshot> findTopByClusterConfigIdAndCapturedAtLessThanEqualOrderByCapturedAtDesc(Long clusterConfigId, java.time.Instant cutoff)  // FEAT-003 prior-period read-back; and Optional<ClusterCostSnapshot> findTopByClusterConfigIdOrderByCapturedAtDesc(Long clusterConfigId)  // newest-overall, for tests. Inherited save(...) is how FEAT-002 persists. Migration version used: V20261022_1__cluster_cost_snapshot.sql (CREATE TABLE/INDEX IF NOT EXISTS; FK cluster_config_id -> kubernetes_cluster_config(id) ON DELETE CASCADE; index ix_cluster_cost_snapshot_cluster_captured on (cluster_config_id, captured_at)). Verified: `mvn -q -o -pl . compile` OK; migration has 3 'IF NOT EXISTS' occurrences.
